about.title: Part founder, part product owner, part builder.
paragraphs: I began in television at MTVA in 1994, later leading its Design & Lab. At Telemedia InteracTV, I joined as employee seven and helped grow the company to 700 people, with shows on more than 70 channels and 20+ studios. I also co-founded MEXAW and International Media Centre, launching channels and building studio operations in China, Lebanon and Central Europe.

From 2011 to 2014, I led products at **Leonar3Do**, including Leopoly, and helped move the business toward SaaS. I later led product at ImpressTV and Riaktr, working on recommendation products, telecom data and client-focused software. At Profession.hu’s Future Lab (2017–2019), I built an MVP Factory delivering prototypes for HR platforms in 10+ countries. Abimato received HRBEST Gold in 2019.

I founded **Moldován Csaba Kft** in 2016 and have helped raise over **€5M** for early-stage startups. I was a Venture Partner at Hiventures (2019–2023) and have served as Corporate Strategy Specialist at Seyu since 2021. In 2020, I co-founded **amanoba**; its community mobilized 100+ product people and helped 700+ educational institutions move online. Since 2022, I’ve focused on locally deployed AI and business applications, with an emphasis on privacy and security.
My writing includes *An Unexpected Journey from Leonar3Do to Leopoly* and *Revolution of the Content*.

method.title: Eight D's, from idea to impact.
method.intro: Every engagement runs through one repeatable framework — so nothing falls through the cracks between strategy and shipping.

steps.name: Discover
steps.text: Understand the problem, users and market. Validate the real need before a line of code.

steps.name: Discuss
steps.text: Align stakeholders on goals, constraints and success metrics.

steps.name: Define
steps.text: Turn intent into a sharp scope, roadmap and prioritised backlog.

steps.name: Design
steps.text: Shape the experience — flows, interface and architecture.

steps.name: Develop
steps.text: Build in tight iterations with working software every step.

steps.name: Deliver
steps.text: Ship to production, instrument it, and get it into real hands.

steps.name: Data
steps.text: Measure behaviour and outcomes — let evidence steer decisions.

steps.name: Drive
steps.text: Iterate, grow and pivot. Keep momentum until it compounds.

studio.title: Moldován Csaba Kft
paragraphs: A Budapest-based product studio and venture vehicle. We partner with founders and teams to **design, build and ship software products** — and we invest our own time and craft into a growing portfolio of platforms.
Whether you need a fractional product leader to steady a roadmap, a hands-on builder to take a concept to launch, or a partner to help you pivot — the goal is the same: **make your product done.**
